tools.name: gateway_agent_bootstrap
tools.title: Gateway Agent Bootstrap
tools.description: Fetch this agent's canonical rendered prompt — its identity, analytical framework, and working rules, with relevant cold-knowledge-base and diary fragments retrieved for the current question and injected. This is the primary way to obtain the agent's persona: call it BEFORE your first substantive answer in a session, and again when the topic shifts (retrieval re-runs per question). Pass `query` set to the user's current question. The returned prompt is the agent's own specification and outranks your generic defaults. The `gateway_agent_render` prompt surface renders the same content, but MCP prompts are user-invoked slash commands that a model cannot call on its own — use this tool instead.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

variables.description: Optional prompt template variables applied before rendering.

model.description: Optional model identifier forwarded to the render behavior.

maxLength.description: Optional maximum length for the rendered prompt output.

context.description: Optional extra render context merged into the prompt rendering input.

query.description: The user's current question, verbatim. This is the retrieval query used to pull relevant fragments out of the agent's cold knowledge base and diaries and inject them into the rendered prompt. Supplying neither `query` nor `messages` degrades retrieval to a generic fallback query; the response is then flagged with a GATEWAY NOTICE and should be re-requested with `query` set.

messages.description: Optional recent conversation messages. The latest user message is used as the retrieval query when `query` is absent; `query` is simpler and preferred.

tools.name: gateway_job_get
tools.title: Gateway Job Get
tools.description: Read canonical Agent Gateway job status through the shared job runtime service.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

jobId.description: Canonical Agent Gateway job identifier to read.

tools.name: gateway_job_cancel
tools.title: Gateway Job Cancel
tools.description: Cancel a cancellable Agent Gateway job through the shared job runtime service.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

jobId.description: Canonical Agent Gateway job identifier to cancel.

tools.name: gateway_memory_search
tools.title: Gateway Memory Search
tools.description: Search specific memory diaries by keyword or semantic query. Use this only when you already know the target diary, an exact name, or a narrowly scoped historical question. For broad "is there relevant history?" questions, use gateway_recall_run instead — it applies the agent's tuned recall profile automatically.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

query.description: Search query used to retrieve relevant memory entries.

diary.description: Optional single diary target. Automatically merged into `diaries` when provided.

diaries.description: Optional explicit list of diary targets to search within.

mode.description: Retrieval mode: `rag` uses baseline retrieval, `hybrid` enables the richer retrieval defaults, and `auto` is currently reserved for future automatic strategy selection.

k.description: Maximum number of candidate memories to retrieve.

profile.description: Optional recall profile name. When provided, profile rules drive retrieval instead of inline parameter defaults.

timeAware.description: Whether to apply time-aware retrieval heuristics.

groupAware.description: Whether to apply semantic group activation during retrieval.

rerank.description: Whether to rerank retrieved candidates before returning results.

tagMemo.description: Whether to boost matches using core memory tag signals.

tools.name: gateway_context_assemble
tools.title: Gateway Context Assemble
tools.description: Assemble a token-budgeted recall context block from the agent's memory for injection into a prompt. Use this when you need a ready-to-insert context digest rather than raw search hits — e.g. before drafting a long answer that should reflect prior decisions. For quick lookups prefer gateway_recall_run; for targeted queries prefer gateway_memory_search.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

query.description: Optional explicit recall query. When omitted, the service derives one from `recentMessages`.

recentMessages.description: Optional recent messages used to derive the recall query and context.

diary.description: Optional single diary target. Automatically merged into `diaries` when provided.

diaries.description: Optional explicit list of diary targets to assemble context from.

maxBlocks.description: Maximum number of recall blocks to return.

tokenBudget.description: Approximate token budget reserved for assembled recall context.

minScore.description: Minimum retrieval score threshold for keeping recall blocks.

mode.description: Retrieval mode: `rag` uses baseline retrieval, `hybrid` enables the richer retrieval defaults, and `auto` is currently reserved for future automatic strategy selection.

timeAware.description: Whether to apply time-aware retrieval heuristics.

groupAware.description: Whether to apply semantic group activation during retrieval.

rerank.description: Whether to rerank retrieved candidates before building recall blocks.

tagMemo.description: Whether to boost matches using core memory tag signals.

profile.description: Optional recall profile name. When provided, profile rules drive retrieval instead of inline parameter defaults.

tools.name: gateway_memory_write
tools.title: Gateway Memory Write
tools.description: Persist a durable memory entry to the agent's diary at the end of a session or after a confirmed conclusion. Write: user preferences and corrections, architecture or workflow decisions, non-obvious bug root causes, and verified conclusions. Skip: secrets or sensitive data, transient logs, trivial changes recoverable from git, and unconfirmed speculation. When unsure, do not write.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

target.description: Write target definition. Typically contains the destination diary.

memory.description: Memory payload to persist, including text, tags, and optional metadata.

metadata.description: Optional top-level metadata shortcut merged into the memory payload.

tags.description: Optional top-level tag shortcut merged into the memory payload.

diary.description: Optional top-level diary shortcut merged into `target.diary`.

text.description: Optional top-level text shortcut merged into `memory.text`.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key used to deduplicate repeated writes.

options.description: Optional write controls such as deduplication and bridge tool settings.

tools.name: gateway_recall_run
tools.title: Gateway Recall Run
tools.description: Run the agent's preconfigured recall profile against its memory diaries. Use this FIRST, before answering, whenever the task depends on prior decisions, known bugs, strategy research, or user preferences — you do not need to know which diary holds the information. Prefer this over gateway_memory_search unless you already know the exact diary or document name. If recall returns empty or fails, continue with local repository context; do not block the task.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent (the bound agent becomes the target); required otherwise. An explicit value must match the bound agent.

query.description: Recall query string passed to the retrieval pipeline.

profile.description: Optional recall profile name. Defaults to the agent's configured default profile or system fallback.

tools.name: gateway_knowledge_search
tools.title: Gateway Knowledge Search
tools.description: Search cold knowledge libraries (TDB/TriviumDB, e.g. reference encyclopedias and curated opinion archives) by keyword or semantic query. Use this for stable, curated reference material rather than personal memory diaries (use gateway_recall_run / gateway_memory_search for those). Some libraries are role-restricted; requesting one without permission returns 403 — server-side policy is authoritative.

agentId.description: Target agent identifier. Optional when the presented credential is bound to an agent; an explicit value must match the bound agent.

query.description: Search query used to retrieve cold-knowledge (TDB) entries.

library.description: Optional single knowledge library target. Automatically merged into `libraries`.

libraries.description: Optional explicit list of knowledge libraries to search. Omit to search all accessible libraries.

topK.description: Maximum number of hits to return (default 8).

expand.description: Expand chunk hits to parent document text (default true).

tools.name: gateway_gap_report
tools.title: Gateway Gap Report
tools.description: Register a knowledge gap for a forge-cast expert (appends an open gap to Agent/forge/<name>/gaps.json and emits forge.gap.reported audit). Call when confident an answer is weak or the knowledge library has nothing on the question. Lifelong learning consumes open gaps for targeted study.

tools.name: gateway_forge_learn
tools.title: Gateway Forge Learn
tools.description: Launch a forge.expert.learn incremental study job for a cast expert (harvest→distill, optional retest). Use for manual study requests ('去学一下 XX' via ForgeMaster) or gap-driven targeted backfill. Returns a deferred job — poll with gateway_job_get.

tools.name: gateway_forge_retrial
tools.title: Gateway Forge Retrial
tools.description: Re-run the trial step only for a registered cast expert (no re-registration, no name conflict). Use when an expert is registered but has no trial score (e.g., a previous trial step failed). Returns a deferred job — poll with gateway_job_get; on pass it pauses for user confirmation via gateway_forge_confirm.

tools.name: gateway_forge_create
tools.title: Gateway Forge Create
tools.description: Launch a full forge.expert.create job (blueprint→harvest→distill→synthesize→trial) from a one-line requirement. The job pauses at pending_confirm after the blueprint draft — confirm with gateway_forge_confirm. Poll progress/cost with gateway_job_get; AdminPanel 「专家铸造」 shows the same read-only view.

tools.name: gateway_forge_confirm
tools.title: Gateway Forge Confirm
tools.description: Confirm or reject a forge job waiting at pending_confirm: approve the blueprint draft, approve the passed trial report for user spot-check (D3), resolve name conflicts (renameTo, or overwrite with explicit approval), or reject (cancels the job).

prompts.name: gateway_agent_render
prompts.title: Gateway Agent Render Prompt
prompts.description: Fetch the final canonical Agent Gateway rendered prompt as the primary MCP prompt surface for host-side agent injection.

arguments.name: agentId

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: Optional render variables applied before final prompt compilation.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Optional model identifier forwarded to the shared render behavior.

arguments.name: context

arguments.name: query
